questions.question: compare Facebook and twitter
questions.solution_html:
• Facebook is a more personal, community-oriented platform that enables detailed
  • sharing of life updates, content creation, and deeper social connections. It is ideal for
  • maintaining personal relationships and exploring interests. Twitter, is a fast-paced
  • platform focused on real-time communication, short-form content, and public
  • conversation. It excels in delivering immediate updates and fostering public discourse
  • particularly on news, politics, and social movements.
questions.final_answer: particularly on news, politics, and social movements

  • technology.

questions.question: Analyse the ethical and legal challenges related to data privacy and security in the context of e-participation platforms. END OF THE QUESTION PAPER ***
questions.solution_html:
• E-participation platforms are increasingly being used to engage citizens in decision
  • making processes, enhance transparency, and promote democracy. Challenges →
  • collection of personal data from citizens they may not fully understand the terms of
  • use or the implications of sharing their personal information. Data Transparency is
  • another challenge , gathering excessive data - Governments and private entities must
  • implement strong data protection policies, ensure transparency and informed consent
  • safeguard citizen privacy, and adhere to relevant legal frameworks to protect the rights
  • of individuals and promote meaningful participation.
